output.reason: [ev-6a341603b700] says only that the metric was renamed to doublewrite_identity_crd_only_total. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so behavior-change (review) at low severity is the right kind. But the same Changed Metrics section, in [ev-df8818f69d5e], says the same old metric was renamed to doublewrite_crd_only_identities. The proposed statement and remediation name a single new metric as settled when the guide itself gives two conflicting names, so the consequence text has to carry that ambiguity.

correction.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count was renamed. The upgrade guide gives the new name as both doublewrite_identity_crd_only_total and doublewrite_crd_only_identities. It still works under the new name, so this is review, not mandatory work.

consequence.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 no longer exposes this metric under the name doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count. The 1.17 upgrade guide gives two different new names for it: doublewrite_identity_crd_only_total and doublewrite_crd_only_identities. Monitoring that refers to the old name should be checked.
consequence.remediation: Check which name Cilium 1.17.0 actually emits (doublewrite_identity_crd_only_total or doublewrite_crd_only_identities). Then update any dashboards, alerts and recording rules that refer to doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count.
